doc.title: Carter Benny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Leonard Feather's recordings and Waltzing the Blues
summary: Feather produced everything Carter recorded there; Waltzing the Blues was Feather's idea and unwritten.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: Leonard, of course, was very involved in your recordings over there, for Vocalion
Oh yeah, everything I think that I did, he produced, everything I did there.
Right. And we might mention one of the more historic ones, and that’s the famous Waltzing the Blues, which . . .
. . . is the first time blues had been recorded in waltz time. I believe Leonard prodded you to do something like that.
The actual piece, is it completely improvised? Was there anything . . .
Oh, I don’t think there was anything written on that.
